acceptanceCriteria: A generic directory-fragment literal does not count as a reader of every concrete ticket file (or is narrowed with a declared read scope), so a ticket-only Corvint diff projects as nonSource, with a test.
body: PR #1314 measured Corvint 99dac5234: 13 .taskman/ paths all remain unknown because the generic `/tickets/` literal in internal/tasks/transaction is treated as a reader of every ticket file. That widens plans for ticket-only commits.

holds.reason: Owner decision: decision 0548's route does not work; a new decision is needed.

title: Corvint's own ticket-only diffs stay UNOWNED_DIRTY_PATH because internal/tasks/transaction's generic /tickets/ literal matches every ticket file (V1-2049 residual)
